mapper.sql: select policy_id, tenant_id, dept_id, period_id, product_id, policy_no, policy_name, version, customer_scope, effective_start, effective_end, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from mem_campaign_policy
mapper.select: where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'

select package_id, policy_id, tenant_id, dept_id, package_name, purchase_quantity, gift_quantity, total_quantity, package_price, sort_no, del_flag from mem_campaign_policy_package where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' order by purchase_quantity desc, sort_no
mapper.insert: insert into mem_campaign_policy (tenant_id, dept_id, period_id, product_id, policy_no, policy_name, version, customer_scope, effective_start, effective_end, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{periodId}, #{productId}, #{policyNo}, #{policyName}, #{version}, #{customerScope}, #{effectiveStart}, #{effectiveEnd}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

insert into mem_campaign_policy_package (policy_id, tenant_id, dept_id, package_name, purchase_quantity, gift_quantity, total_quantity, package_price, sort_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{policyId}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{packageName}, #{purchaseQuantity}, #{giftQuantity}, #{totalQuantity}, #{packagePrice}, #{sortNo}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update mem_campaign_policy set period_id = #{periodId}, product_id = #{productId}, policy_name = #{policyName}, customer_scope = #{customerScope}, effective_start = #{effectiveStart}, effective_end = #{effectiveEnd}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from mem_campaign_policy_package where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.update: update mem_campaign_policy set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
update mem_campaign_policy set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
